events.name: ITEM_CLICK
events.description: When set, clicking a card emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row }. Omit = cards are not clickable.

events.name: SELECTION
events.description: Selection change event name (emits UI:{selectionEvent} with { selectedIds: string[] })

events.name: LOAD_MORE
events.description: Event emitted when more items needed: UI:{loadMoreEvent}

events.name: VIEW
events.description: User opened a record from the list.

events.name: DataGridLoaded
events.description: DataGrid rows finished loading; payload.data holds the collection.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Accepts
overridableConfigKeys.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-busy
overridableConfigKeys.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-current
overridableConfigKeys.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-describedby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-expanded
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-hidden
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-labelledby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-live
overridableConfigKeys.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-pressed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Toggle-button state.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-selected
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Class Name
overridableConfigKeys.description: Additional CSS classes

overridableConfigKeys.label: Cols
overridableConfigKeys.description: Number of columns (uses auto-fit if omitted)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Columns
overridableConfigKeys.description: Alias for `fields` — the compiler emits `columns` for field defs.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dir
overridableConfigKeys.description: Text direction of this element's content.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dnd Item Id Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dnd Root
overridableConfigKeys.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drag Group
overridableConfigKeys.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drop Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty Action
overridableConfigKeys.description: Create-the-first-item action.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty Description
overridableConfigKeys.description: What will appear here once rows exist.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty Icon
overridableConfigKeys.description: Domain icon for the empty state.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty Title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Specific title ('No orders yet').

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter
overridableConfigKeys.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter Delay
overridableConfigKeys.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Error
overridableConfigKeys.description: Error state

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fields
overridableConfigKeys.description: Field definitions for rendering each card. The pattern contract in `@almadar/core/patterns` documents `columns` as the wire-format alias the compiler emits — both names resolve to the same shape here. Pass either.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Gap
overridableConfigKeys.description: Gap between cards

overridableConfigKeys.label: Has More
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether more items are available for infinite scroll

overridableConfigKeys.label: Image Field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field name containing an image URL for card thumbnails

overridableConfigKeys.label: Infinite Scroll
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable infinite scroll loading

overridableConfigKeys.label: Is Loading
overridableConfigKeys.description: Loading state

overridableConfigKeys.label: Item Actions
overridableConfigKeys.description: Per-item action buttons

overridableConfigKeys.label: Item Click Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: When set, clicking a card emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row }. Omit = cards are not clickable.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Lang
overridableConfigKeys.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Load More Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted when more items needed: UI:{loadMoreEvent}

overridableConfigKeys.label: Look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the `entity-table` look enum so data-grid / data-list / entity-table share one knob name from authors.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Inline Actions
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max inline primary action buttons before the rest collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu. Omit = all inline.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Min Card Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Minimum card width in pixels (used when cols is not set, default 280)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Page Size
overridableConfigKeys.description: Max items to show before 'Show More' button. Defaults to 0 (disabled).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Position Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Relations Data
overridableConfigKeys.description: Relation display data: { fieldName: [{value, label}] } — injected server-side by the runtime (relation-option injection) or bound by compiled codegen; resolves stored foreign ids to display names for a field whose type is relation. Same contract DetailPanel takes.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reorder Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Bus event fired on in-container reorder. Payload: { id, oldIndex, newIndex }

overridableConfigKeys.label: Role
overridableConfigKeys.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Scroll X
overridableConfigKeys.description: Lay items in a single horizontally-scrolling row (kanban columns) sized to `minCardWidth` instead of a wrapping grid.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Selectable
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable multi-select with checkboxes

overridableConfigKeys.label: Selection Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Selection change event name (emits UI:{selectionEvent} with { selectedIds: string[] })

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fetch its own rows on mount?
overridableConfigKeys.description: true (default) = standalone mount self-populates on INIT. false = a composing atom owns the fetch and routes its loaded event here — suppresses the wrapper's own un-hydrated fetch so it cannot race the composer's.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sortable
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tab Index
overridableConfigKeys.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Viewer's role
overridableConfigKeys.description: The viewer's role that each action's `roles` is checked against; bind it at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`). Empty = only actions with no `roles` show.

capabilities: admin table, records grid, user list, CRUD list, manage-records view, spreadsheet-style data grid, sortable columns
